package.name: bonbon_speech_ai
package.description: ASR/TTS routing layer sitting between bonbon_speech/bonbon_tts's real backends and bonbon_ai_model_registry's capability registry. Implements the ReSpeaker -> VAD/wake-word -> ASR router -> language detector -> transcript normalizer -> intent detector -> RAG/LLM gateway -> TTS router -> speaker output pipeline, with hospital phrase boosting and entity correction (doctor names, room/token numbers, departments). Does not re-implement VAD/wake-word/ASR/TTS inference itself -- bonbon_speech and bonbon_tts already own that; this package decides WHICH backend runs, in what order of preference, honestly reflecting real availability (rule 1).
